note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled at backend/library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline with fetch_verse_text("owb-am", ref). Every quotation (each chapter's epigraph, the «ለመንጋዎች» of Psalm 104:14 in chapter 8 and Boaz's words from Ruth 2:16 in chapter 10) was re-quoted to it verbatim on 2026-11-18, replacing the earlier 1962-register and translator-written wording; a partial verse is the shortest contiguous OWB span carrying the clause, and where the clauses quoted sat in non-adjacent verses (Psalm 147:16-18, Psalm 65:9-10, Proverbs 24:30-31) the whole verses are quoted.

Rows left self_rendered are the author's own allusions and paraphrases in prose (e.g. 1 Corinthians 10:13, Revelation 21:4, Galatians 6:7), not quotations; they carry no Scripture wording to re-quote. One prose echo was bridged to OWB's wording: chapter 11 now says the farmer does not thresh «ያለማቋረጥ» (OWB Isaiah 28:28) before its recurring «ለዘላለም».
